cases.sentence: Моисей поднялся на ___ Нева с Маавской равнины на вершину Фазги.
cases.translation: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah.
cases.explain: The preposition на (onto) with the accusative case indicates motion onto or up.

cases.sentence: Там Господь показал ему всю ту землю, от Галаада до Дана, все владения Нефалима, и всю землю Иуды до самого Западного ___.
cases.translation: There the Lord showed him all the land, from Gilead to Dan, all the land of Judah to the western sea.
cases.explain: In the phrase 'Западного моря' (Western sea), the genitive case is used in the appositive construction.

cases.translation: I will give it to your offspring.
cases.explain: The verb дать (to give) with the meaning 'give to someone' takes the dative case for the recipient.

cases.sentence: И ___ слуга Господа, умер там, в Моаве, как и сказал Господь.
cases.translation: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in Moab, as the Lord had said.
cases.explain: Моисей is the subject of the verb умер (died), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я позволил тебе увидеть ее своими ___.
cases.translation: I have caused you to see it with your own eyes.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) indicating the means or instrument takes the instrumental case.

cases.translation: No one knows where his tomb is to this day.
cases.explain: Могила is the subject of the implied verb 'is', so it requires the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус же исполнился духом мудрости, потому что Моисей возложил на него ___.
cases.translation: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him.
cases.explain: The verb возложил (laid) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: С тех пор в Израиле не было пророка, подобного Моисею, которого Господь знал бы лицом к ___.
cases.translation: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case in the idiom 'лицом к лицу' (face to face).

reading.ru: Смерть Моисея Затем Моисей поднялся на гору Нева с Маавской равнины на вершину Фазги, что напротив Иерихона.
reading.question: What did Moses do before his death?
options: He went up Mount Nebo, opposite Jericho, from the plains of Moab
He built an altar to the Lord
He instructed Joshua to conquer the land
reading.correct: He went up Mount Nebo, opposite Jericho, from the plains of Moab
reading.explain: The text states 'Моисей поднялся на гору Нева с Маавской равнины... что напротив Иерихона' — Moses ascended Mount Nebo.

reading.ru: Там Господь показал ему всю ту землю, от Галаада до Дана, все владения Нефалима, и всю землю Иуды до самого Западного моря.
reading.question: What did the Lord show Moses from Mount Nebo?
options: All the land from Gilead to Dan and Judah to the Western Sea
reading.correct: All the land from Gilead to Dan and Judah to the Western Sea
reading.explain: The verse says 'Господь показал ему всю ту землю, от Галаада до Дана... до самого Западного моря' — the Lord showed him all the land.

reading.ru: Я позволил тебе увидеть ее своими глазами, но ты не вступишь в нее.
reading.question: What did God tell Moses about entering the promised land?
options: He could see it but would not enter it
He would lead the people into it
He would receive a double portion
He would receive it after death
reading.correct: He could see it but would not enter it
reading.explain: God says 'Я позволил тебе увидеть ее... но ты не вступишь в нее' — you will see it but not enter it.

reading.ru: Моисею было сто двадцать лет, когда он умер, но глаза его не ослабли и силы не пропало.
reading.question: What was remarkable about Moses' death?
options: He was 120 years old, but his eyesight and strength had not failed
He lived much longer than other people
He refused to die until God forced him
reading.correct: He was 120 years old, but his eyesight and strength had not failed
reading.explain: The text states 'Моисею было сто двадцать лет... но глаза его не ослабли и силы не пропало' — his eyes were not dim and strength was not gone.

reading.ru: Израилетяне оплакивали Моисея на Маавской равнине тридцать дней, пока время плачи и скорби не прошло.
reading.question: How did the Israelites respond to Moses' death?
options: They mourned him for thirty days on the plains of Moab
They immediately chose Joshua as his replacement
They abandoned their faith in God
They returned to Egypt in grief
reading.correct: They mourned him for thirty days on the plains of Moab
reading.explain: The text says 'Израилетяне оплакивали Моисея на Маавской равнине тридцать дней' — they wept for Moses thirty days.

reading.ru: Никто не превзошел Моисея в знамениях и чудесах, которые он совершил в Египте по слову Господню над фараоном, над всеми его приближенными и над всей его землей.
reading.question: How do the texts describe Moses' miracles compared to other prophets?
options: No one equaled Moses in the signs and wonders he performed in Egypt
Many prophets had greater power than Moses
Moses performed miracles only in Sinai
God forbade comparing Moses' miracles to others
reading.correct: No one equaled Moses in the signs and wonders he performed in Egypt
reading.explain: The text states 'Никто не превзошел Моисея в знамениях и чудесах' — no one surpassed Moses in signs and wonders.
